$comment: Compliance configuration for the X (Twitter) post generator. Legal/compliance may edit this file without code changes. Every value here is read at runtime by src/social/config.js.
disclosure: Educational market analysis only. Not investment advice. Trading involves risk.
$disclosurePlacement: 'post' = the disclosure line is appended to every post and validated; 'bio' = it lives in the account bio only (set it there!) and posts carry the required hashtags (#NFA #DYOR) as the in-post marker. Flip to 'post' to restore per-post disclosures without a code change.
$marketHolidays: NYSE full-day closures. Auto-publish refuses on these dates (a report generated on a holiday only re-shows the prior session).

autoPublish.$comment: Guard-railed unattended publishing (tv social auto). candidateSource 'report-cohort' posts exactly the names the report lists under Calls and Puts (its flow-trend gate is the authority; the classifier only supplies the label and can never upgrade one). Every guard below must hold; nothing here can override the stale-data gate. SOCIAL_AUTO_PUBLISH=0 in the environment is a kill switch.
autoPublish.$via: 'api' = publish through the X API from this machine; 'browser' = prepare and approve only (status ready_to_post) and let the scheduled Claude task post them through the logged-in Chrome, then `tv social record` marks them published.
autoPublish.$maxPostsPerRun: Publishing strategy: ONE highest-quality setup per run. Candidates are ranked by quality (candidateOrder) and the first that clears every guard is posted; nothing is forced when none does.
autoPublish.$candidateOrder: "quality" ranks the report cohort by the classifier: CONFIRMED before WATCH, then confidence, then |score|; ties broken by historical engagement for that setup type (docs/social/insights.json, tv social metrics report), then symbol. "report" keeps cohort order.
autoPublish.$minConfidence: The quality threshold. A Low-confidence read is never the day’s post, even if it is the only candidate — the run then publishes nothing.
autoPublish.$skipTracked: A symbol with an open lifecycle record (DEVELOPING/CONFIRMED) is never re-posted as a new setup; its follow-ups cover it until it resolves.

hashtags.$comment: Sweep setup format: 0-2 tags — the cashtag as a hashtag (#ETH) plus one asset-class tag. maxTotal is the cap for SETUP posts; educational posts have their own, larger cap (education.maxTags) because the video and intro posts carry the #AITradeSchool archive tag on top of their reach tags; explainer lessons end on exactly the two tags in education.hashtags. No required marker tags: the disclosure lives in the bio AND on every chart, which is why charts.requireForPublish must be true (config loader enforces it). Put #NFA #DYOR back in required to restore the in-post marker.

cta.text: Which level gets hit first — {level1} or {level2}? 👇

charts.$comment: Sweep chart card (scripts/render-chart-sweep.py): near-square, mobile-first. requireForPublish=true is REQUIRED while hashtags.required is empty — the chart carries the only in-post disclaimer, so a render failure blocks the post rather than publishing it unmarked.
charts.$volumeLine: Adds 'Volume: 1.4× 20-day avg' to the post from the chart's candle data (integrity-checked against the chart).

$charLimit: X Premium account: long posts allowed. Set 280 for a non-Premium account (the fit ladder trims CTA → extra hashtags → narrative → …).
$plainLanguage: Adds the one-sentence "In plain terms:" reading of the setup (src/social/sweep-labels.js) under the indicator line, so a reader who does not know CMF or RSI still gets the point.
$postFormat: "sweep" = the Daily Setup Sweep layout (headline verb, two levels, RVOL/score line, level-question CTA, 0-2 hashtags). "classic" restores the previous multi-line layout without a code change.
$priceDisplay: "compact" shows whole dollars once a price is in the thousands ($2,579). Compliance accepts any value a report level rounds to at the precision shown. "exact" keeps full precision.

brand.name: Daily Setup Sweep
brand.seriesLine: Daily Setup Sweep · tracked to a daily close beyond a level · scored every Friday
brand.$seriesLine: Recurring-format footer on every setup post (before the Data line). Set to null to drop it.

$cta: Engagement line before the Data line; dropped first when the post does not fit. {level1} = the 🎯 level, {level2} = the 🛑 level. With only one level the generator asks a single-level question instead.

followUps.$comment: Event-driven follow-ups (tv social track), detected on DAILY CLOSES only: a close beyond the 🎯 level = BREAKOUT UPDATE, beyond the 🛑 level = INVALIDATED, an intraday touch of 🎯 without a close beyond = LEVEL TEST (postLevelTests), a later report confirming a DEVELOPING setup = CONFIRMED update. After maxAgeSessions bars without resolution the setup EXPIRES quietly (no post, not scored).
followUps.$maxUpdatesPerRun: Cap on non-terminal follow-ups (LEVEL TEST, CONFIRMED update) per run so a busy morning does not flood the feed. BREAKOUT and INVALIDATED updates always post — they are the accountability record.
followUps.$maxEventAgeHours: Freshness window for follow-ups, replacing maxReportAgeHours for kind=followup. A follow-up is dated by the daily bar that triggered it and the next run after a Friday close is Monday morning (65h; ~90h over a holiday weekend), so 96h. Older events are still audited as skipped, never back-posted.

scorecard.$comment: Weekly Setup Scorecard (tv social scorecard): counts from docs/social/setups.jsonl across BOTH queues, queued on the stocks queue every Friday. Only one config should have this enabled or the account posts two scorecards.

premarket.$comment: Premarket market-direction post (tv social premarket), weekdays ~8 AM via the premarket-market-direction task, built from docs/reports/premarket/premarket-<date>.json. Hook + bias + confidence, top 3 drivers, SPY levels, sectors, the one flip event, CTA, short disclaimer, 0-2 hashtags. Only one config should have this enabled.

video.$comment: Daily Technical Analysis Education Video (tv social video), every day via the post-daily-chart-video task. One non-repeating topic per day from src/social/video.js: 1-2 s hook, animated chart with levels/arrows/captions, What it means / How traders use it, end card 'Save this • Follow for daily chart education', footer on every frame. Text carries no ticker (compliance kind video). Only one config should have this enabled.

education.$hashtags: The exact tag line every AI Trade School lesson ends on, in order. Explainer posts take this list verbatim (education.lessonTags) and do NOT get archiveTag appended — the lesson header '🎓 AI Trade School — Lesson #NN' is the visible branding, so the post does not also spend a tag on it. Video and intro posts still go through educationalTags and still carry the archive tag.
education.$comment: Educational explainer posts (tv social educate), Tuesday and Friday 8 AM via the post-education-explainer task. One topic per post from src/social/education.js, rotated so the curriculum cycles, published as a numbered 'AI Trade School' lesson (header, title, hook, up to five points, 👇 question, two tags). Lesson numbers are per topic and permanent — see lessonNumbers() in src/social/education.js. The card is 1080x1350 (Instagram 4:5) with the footer text above and the lesson number in the header chip; the text carries no ticker (compliance blocks one). Only one config should have this enabled.
education.$archiveTag: The archive tag for the video, launch-lesson and pinned-intro posts (educationalTags appends it last). Explainer lessons no longer carry it — they lead with the '🎓 AI Trade School — Lesson #NN' header instead and end on exactly the two tags in education.hashtags. Distinctive to this account on purpose — a generic tag would mix our lessons in with everyone else's. Changing it orphans every post already published under the old tag.
education.$maxTags: Hashtag cap for educational posts (explainer, video, launch lesson, intro) — up to two reach tags plus the archive tag, so 3. Explainer lessons use only two of it. Separate from hashtags.maxTotal so widening the lesson posts never loosens the setup posts.

launch.$comment: The 14-post launch sequence (tv social launch), the running order that establishes what the account teaches before the daily rotations take over. The plan of record is LAUNCH_SEQUENCE in src/social/launch.js; only items with a generator there can be built, and this command never improvises post text. Item 1 is the pinned introduction — pin it by hand after posting.

thread.$comment: Surplus quality setups from the same sweep are queued as replies under the day's hero post instead of standalone tweets (kind 'thread', not tracked/scored). 0 disables.

closeUpdate.$comment: tv social close-update: a CLOSE CHECK reply under today's setup post with the last price vs the setup price and the 🎯/🛑 status so far. Level outcomes are still settled only on the daily close by the tracker.
